10 floor objects carry the not-stated-in-protocol flag instead of a source reference. shellgen attributes everything it builds to the manifest's documentRef; a placeholder is not a reading of that document.

Activities are chained within their parent, never across a parent boundary. 2 section headers carry childIds; their children form separate chains. Same rule shellgen applies to criteria groups: a chain is a sequence within one group, not a flattening of the tree.

No encounterAxis declared. This SoA types its column properties as ['epoch', 'period', 'study_day'] -- none of them labels the columns as visits, so naming an Encounter per column would assert a classification the table does not print. Encounters are omitted; ScheduledActivityInstance.encounterId is 0..1 so the document stays conformant. To emit them, declare encounterAxis in the manifest, the same shape as epochAxis.

activityIds is a plain set of references. This SoA prints 16 distinct mark values, so a reference alone loses everything except 'this activity happens in this column'. Non-'X' marks and cell-scoped footnote markers are carried in an ExtensionAttribute on 10 of the instances. USDM v4 has no cell-scoped annotation that is not a Condition.

The rest scope to whole activities (17 attachments) or whole columns (4) and are carried as ExtensionAttributes: USDM's cell-scoped annotation is Condition, and a source-section pointer or a definition is not a condition. 0 annotations reference neither and are not emitted.

Epoch resolved from consolidated property prop-001 (typed 'epoch'), 4 printed values mapped to declared epochs. 10 of 10 columns bound. This mapping is an interpretation of the extraction, not a fact the extraction records; it lives here and in this log rather than in the consolidated schema.

3 timings derived mechanically from property prop-003, anchored on xcol-003 ('D1 (±1)'). Only values matching a plain study day (optionally with a symmetric window) are converted; the offset is a difference of study days emitted as P<n>D. Columns outside the anchor's prop-002 value are excluded, because a day number that restarts per cycle is not a study day.
